title: TenderAI corpus annotation
description: Ground truth for one tender document. Real and synthetic documents use the same contract, so a real-tender corpus can be dropped in without changing eval_harness.py.

doc_id.description: Unique identifier; also the annotation filename stem.

pdf.description: Path to the PDF, relative to the corpus/ directory.

source.description: Provenance. Papers must report synthetic and real results separately.

generator_note.description: Free-text caveat about how the document was produced.

notes.description: Annotator notes; for real documents, record the source URL and retrieval date here.

fields.description: Document-level ground truth, mirroring TenderDetails in app/schemas.py. Monetary values use the money object so that surface form and numeric value are both recorded.

questions.description: Retrieval evaluation items. A retrieval is scored a hit when gold_span appears in a retrieved chunk after whitespace normalization.

query.description: Natural-language question. Must NOT quote gold_span verbatim, or retrieval is trivially solved by lexical overlap.

gold_span.description: Exact text from the PDF that answers the query. Verified against extracted text by `--mode smoke`.

field.description: Key in `fields` this question corresponds to, when applicable.

value.description: Normalized numeric amount in the base unit of `currency`.

raw.description: Surface form as written in the document, e.g. 'Rs. 5 crore'. Retained so numeric normalization can be evaluated.
